verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's own docs describe a ready-to-use checkout (Checkout Pro) that redirects customers to a payment page hosted by Mercado Pago. Supporting features include guest payment without an account, a return URL after approval, 3DS 2.0 and configurable payment methods, so no custom payment UI is needed. The 'conversion-optimized' part of the story is never explicitly claimed or measured; guest checkout only implies it. missing for 10: explicit evidence the hosted page is conversion-optimized (conversion claims or metrics), independent or hands-on corroboration of the redirect flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Ready-to-use checkout. Redirect customers to a payment page hosted by Mercado Pago.
Option to pay without a Mercado Pago account, as a guest user
